job.job_description:
The full stack Software Engineers skillset should have Angular, Python (includes API and Data Analytics), Big Query, GCP, DevSecOps (CI/CD pipeline Tekton/Terraform).

Participate in the design, development, and deployment of applications on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) using Python and Spring Boot.

Implement and manage connections to BigQuery and SQL databases, ensuring efficient data retrieval and storage.

Develop responsive and dynamic user interfaces using angular, ensuring seamless integration with backend services.

Design, implement, and maintain Jenkins pipelines for continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) processes, ensuring smooth and automated deployment cycles.

Implement and adhere to Software Craftsmanship tools for maintaining code quality and integrity

Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code, adhering to coding standards and best practices.

Monitor and optimize application performance, identifying and resolving bottlenecks to ensure high availability and scalability.

Develop and execute unit tests, integration tests, and automated tests to ensure the reliability and robustness of the application. Debug and resolve issues as they arise.

Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for code, APIs, and development processes.
